architecture.summary: The complete candidate keeps the optional hosted PostgreSQL settings boundary from S2-01a and separates it from internal diagnostics. System logs now belong to src/logs/system, with SystemLog at application, MCP, HTTP and CLI boundaries. SystemLog is now exported from system-logger.ts as Pick<SystemLogger, 'info' | 'error'> instead of a separate interface module. The info/error callable shape and structural plain-object compatibility stay the same; the implements clause is removed to avoid a circular type definition. This source refactor changes type declarations and imports only and adds no runtime, owner, or diagram change; ConsoleSystemLogger and OtelSystemLogger retain source location, severity and output behavior. Audit logs belong to src/logs/audit: the moved private settings store/runtime keep their SQL, revision and lifetime behavior. A single concrete AuditLog class exposes only toolCompleted and administrationChanged, projects named nested fields, adds no source location/stack and catches synchronous sink failures. AuditEventSink remains the provider-neutral destination contract; no duplicate AuditLog role interface remains. Its metadata-only API has no production caller/exporter; S2-03a must add redacted bounded tool inputs/results before capture. No system stream is exposed to customers and no log viewer is added. Component rules split the former logging owner into system-logs and audit-logs, declare their exact imports and forbid dependencies between them. The registry shows current wiring versus the unwired audit API. No external auth/MCP/SQL behavior or deployment topology changes beyond parent S2-01a; no live migration or rollout. T2 review covers the new component and event contract, plus the retained parent datastore boundary. No ADR is added. Test files mirror the two log owners under test/<type>/logging/system and test/<type>/logging/audit; destination settings and storage tests use audit. This path change preserves test behavior and gate selection.
